title: Regularity of a Noetherian ring is local
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $A$ is regular in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme] if and only if $A_{\mathfrak q}$ is a regular local ring for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset A$.

source.place: Algebra, Definition Tag 00OD (definition-regular), which defines a regular ring as Noetherian with all local rings regular local

proof.text: By [def-weil-regular-scheme], a Noetherian ring $A$ is regular precisely when every localization $A_{\mathfrak q}$ at a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset A$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a regular local ring. This is the statement.

lemma isRegularRing_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] : IsRegularRing R ↔
